svg.title: Linear: issue, project and comment tools from Linear's MCP server
svg.desc: Inside your agent, the Linear capability connects to Linear's hosted MCP server with a bearer token, and the model sees the server's tools under the linear_ prefix, such as linear_list_issues. Your auth function returns the token for each run from its deps. With read_only=True the capability connects to the read-only endpoint, mcp.linear.app/mcp/readonly, instead of mcp.linear.app/mcp.
